a.text: ♪The papyrus reeds sway by the river, its waters of purest lazurite♪
♪It wends its way by the golden dunes, fed by our gifts of gems♪
♪May I see Him by the waterside, may I follow Him to eternity♪

steps.text: Amidst the ardent applause and passionate singing, the winners stiffly walk along the shining, bejeweled street.
A reed boat bearing the heavy weight of history slowly sinks into the river. Golden slipper and Minoan silver medal alike become no more than a string of bubbles.

steps.name: Rashad
steps.text: Regret? How could I possibly have any regrets? Meeting you has been the best thing to happen to me this entire competition, Hatshepsut Hanim!

steps.name: Rashad
steps.text: What worth would a competition ranking hold compared to such privilege...? If I may be so bold, I believe a group photo of us losers with the champion would be fittingly commemorative.

steps.name: Rashad
steps.text: Would you do me the honor of having a photo with me, resplendent Hatshepsut Hanim? If you would hold the first-place prize statue as well, that would be perfect.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Haha, of course... Thank you for your kind words...

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I joined in a most absurd competition.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Yeah, that was absurd indeed.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I intended to seek history, honor the feats of heroes past, be steadfast in my pursuit of victory, and confront fate itself.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Yeah, confronting fate and... the other thing. Basically, your ten old silver medals are a single shiny new one.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: But don't worry. This is Sargon, after all, so that's no failure.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: 'Golden sands above, gold itself below.' As the lords ameer and padishahs say, sand can be as precious as gold.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Don't sweat it. Maybe you'll go down some windy road, you'll find yourself recognized, and that golden cup will be handed right over.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Handed over?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Let's say, maybe you were to chat with the lucky winner of the cup, and wheedle your way into his trust...

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: —You're right!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: The treasure I put forth was recognized. This means that Minoan culture itself was also recognized.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Even if the assessment of the judges was strikingly superficial, the scoring of the silver medals and my position are sufficient proof that even Sargonian historians hold a basic respect for Minos.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I should have words with the collector of the goblet. If he were to understand the deep history behind it, perhaps he would be willing to sell it back to me at a price I can afford.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: You call that recognition?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Well, if it's enough to cheer you up, I guess we'll call that a victory.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Thank you very much, Narantuya. You are too kind.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Just like the wise men debating around the white columns, you have awoken me. I will not lose the honor that those silver medals represented. In fact, I have now won even more in turn.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: The trick played upon me by fate is unworthy of notice, by comparison.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Moreover, if immersing those medals in the water would aid the people to see what they wish to see, then I am happy to serve.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: If throwing this gem into the river would summon the god I've heard so much talk of, then I—

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: WAIT!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I can see you're feeling a bit better, but calm down. Don't throw it away.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I have a plan... Or I guess, I have a person I wish to see.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: If you don't really care about the gem, could I... borrow it for a while?

steps.name: Ajani
steps.text: The traps are ready.

steps.name: Ajani
steps.text: Relax, I was real careful putting them together. The more someone knows, the less they'll suspect.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Ajazi
steps.text: I also slipped the invitation into the girl's bag. I made sure to wear gloves for handling artifacts, no way I left any fingerprints behind.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Nice work.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: I'll handle the back end of our plan. Any questions from you two?

steps.name: Ajazi
steps.text: I have one! I don't understand why the Padishah's daughter would fall for our bait?

steps.name: Ajazi
steps.text: This gem doesn't seem that special. It's got lots of impurities, like the stone Ajani and I pulled up from the sewer the other day...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Don't worry about what the rich folk think.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Watch the door tonight. Keep your eyes peeled. Don't let her send anyone over to take it before the time is right.

steps.name: Ajazi
steps.text: Yeah, okay... We won't let you down this time.

steps.name: Ajani
steps.text: That's right! We won't let anyone in!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Meow?
Mio arrives before the table, having deftly avoided every snare in the heavily-trapped room.
The glimmering gem on the table is reflected in the cloudbeast's bright eyes.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: An anonymous letter, alongside an indistinct photo of the gem. The letter specifies a time and place for you to be, alone.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: An incredibly obvious trap. You should not go, Pepe.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Well, I have to go. How else am I supposed to get the gem?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: But what?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: You agreed to take me to the man-made lake in the city tonight.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Did I say that? Or maybe you misremembered and it's actually tomorrow night?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Ever since my brain was replaced, I have not misremembered a single thing.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: If that's true, you would have remembered where all the gems were.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: You could ask Anat. She wrote a loooooot of official-looking documents about you lately.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: I also have a few observational reports and paragraphs of a draft for a paper on this ancient general, actually.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Maybe she can take you there.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: ...I might need to take a few more shifts, if so.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Do you really have no idea who sent this letter?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: The tourist who got second place seemed like a nice lady.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I might have been too easy to read at the Harvest Gathering. Everyone could probably tell I wanted the gem.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: But we need it to get more information out of Zubayr. Whether it's info on my hidden treasure or data for your thesis.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Even so, I advise you not to take the risk.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Even if I've been across all of Sargon by now?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: I do recall you nearly failing to make it back twice when we were still in school. Good thing Titi and I decided to look for you both times.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Oh yeah. You recruited a team of adventurers on burdenbeasts to find me, all so I could judge which of the two of you translated some ancient document more accurately.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: If Titi was here, I might have some backing on going to the meet-up spot.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Good thing she isn't here.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: ...She's not? Where is she, then?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: 'Cause inconvenience'... She said that like I was out to mess things up for her.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: *sigh* I helped her out with all the documents before. She wouldn't faint from all the pressure at the office, right?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: —! Wh-What was that noise?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: If you're my cute little jewel construct, then come out like a good kid. No need to freak me out...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I'm going to count to three. If you're not out by then, I'm going to use my Arts on you. You've been warned.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: One, two... three!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Meow—!!!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Oh, darn it! It's you again, little cloudbeast!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Sorry, buddy. Do forgive me. *sigh* Alright, here, some pats on the head, please don't get mad.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I know you're a bit of a bad-tempered scratcher, but let me explain! I've got a good reason for being a bit jittery today!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Meow...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Do you still remember when we were all at the museum earlier? I got freaked out by a bunch of things suddenly jumping all over the place.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: ...And then, today, I got in another fight with Anat.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Please, please, please don't be as mad at me as her, you cute little cloudbeast you.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Purring)

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I know, I know, we're always getting into fights—over academic matters, of course.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I know that she really wants to publish her research for everyone to see.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I also know that it's not easy to get the opportunity to hold a special exhibit like this, so she's being real cautious, and also kinda overstressed...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: So stressed that in the end, she didn't dare press on with her original goal.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: It's obvious I'm trying to make sure she doesn't give up on the special exhibit, right?
Medjehtiqedti unconsciously speeds up her cloudbeast petting.
As she does, Mio purrs louder and louder.
But the girl pays no heed. She is lost in her thoughts, petting and petting and petting and petting...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: She used to be real quiet in the past. Whenever she was nervous, her arms and legs would flail about.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Whenever she'd have to give a speech, everyone would be snickering at her by the end of it.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: But even if her voice was overpowered by the laughter, she would persevere and finish her speech.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: *sigh* If only I could just rub her ears to give her the courage to persevere in other things.
Medjehtiqedti cups the cloudbeast's face in her hands and rubs it vigorously as she vents her feelings, without the slightest bit of interest in why the cloudbeast is purring so loudly.
Suddenly, she feels a warmth in the palm of her hand.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Whoa! Was that a hairball?! Don't spit it on my sleeve!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: —Eh?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: A jewel?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Maybe I could go to the meet-up spot alone, but with a monitoring device hidden on me. We could get some private security to lie in ambush nearby.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: It's far too last-minute for that, Pepe. Security companies won't have the manpower on the eve of the Flood Festival, not to mention you can't negotiate with them in the middle of the night.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Well... How about renting an aircraft to support me if needed?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Such a flying object would be rather suspicious.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I could smash the door in with my hammer, give them a good fright?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: That does seem like it could work...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: ...But would that not be damaging a historical building?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: *cough* I guess that would be a debatable too. Though I'm not sure any building is anywhere near as historical as you...

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: I am rather fond of what the people who came after me have left behind—

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Good! Evening! Everyoneeeeeee!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Oh? You're here too, Pepe? Perfect.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Can you all guess what I just ran into on the road earlier?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Good timing, Titi! We've been discussing something really important, and I need your support here—

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Quick, help me make Pepe see sense.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: If this was an opportunity to excavate an important historical site, would you just give up because you were in a bit of danger?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: You of all should know that an excavation requires patience! You're just eager to prove yourself against your brother right now! This is all just...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Wow, you're really not pulling any punches this time around, Anat...

spans.text: not pulling any punches this time around, Anat...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: *sigh* Nobody going to take a guess?

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: Your clothes are covered in fur.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Thank you for indulging me, Zubayr Effendi. Correct, I ran into a little cloudbeast.

steps.name: Zubayr
steps.text: In my age, the people believed that cloudbeasts were bringers of good fortune.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: It turns out that in this age, I'm a believer too.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: It spit out a gemstone full of luck for me.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: ...A what?!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Let me see, please!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Hold it.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Anat says you agreed to invest in a new exhibition hall in return for her lending you a gem out of the museum collection.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Alright, I hear you, I'll make an investment in your name.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: No, Pepe.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I hope you... No, all of you will agree with me on something else.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Pepe, Anat and... Zubayr Effendi.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I think this jewel can grant our wishes.
